about: A REAL response captured from the FASALYTICS historical market API (sanitized: shortened only). Not a synthetic fixture.

meta.notice: Historical records loaded from static files. They are not live or current market data, and nothing here is a forecast.
meta.unit_note: Prices are assumed to be INR per quintal (unit_basis "assumed_from_documentation"); the source file states no unit.

geography_reference.note: A third-party mirror of the Local Government Directory as of December 2022. It is not a verified current registry.

meta.market_verification: Market identities are created from source labels. No authoritative market list exists, so every market is "unverified".
meta.separation: Mandi-level rows only. Missing mandi prices are never filled from state or national data, and this dataset has no arrivals.
